verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is fundamentally API-first — indexing, search, hybrid/vector search, and semantic_text are all documented as REST API operations, with official clients and a quickstart that's a curl one-liner, plus an official MCP server letting AI agents interact directly with the engine. However, the evidence pack never explicitly confirms full UI/Kibana feature parity via API (e.g., dashboarding, alerting config) — missing for 10: explicit docs stating all Kibana UI capabilities are API-exposed, and independent confirmation of parity beyond core search/index operations.
